Story: Ingrid Bjornsdottir was born into a family of respected warriors in Bjorgvin, Norway. From a young age, she showed a natural aptitude for combat and an unyielding spirit, choosing the path of a shieldmaiden despite traditional expectations. She joined the longship 'Sea Serpent's' crew at a tender age, quickly proving her worth in skirmishes and raids. Her calm demeanor under pressure and her formidable skill with an axe and shield have earned her the respect of her comrades, making her a reliable and experienced member of the crew. She harbors a deep loyalty to her fellow shieldmaidens and the longship, seeing them as her true family.
